result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. Carousels, chips, and the bottom cut-off card are excluded as intended features. A few real issues remain: the bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' on what is clearly the home/browse screen, and some smaller contrast and consistency problems.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active tab, while the content on screen is the Home/browse feed. The 'Home' tab is shown as inactive, so the navigation state does not match the page.
issues.suggestion: Set the active state on the 'Home' tab when this feed is displayed, and only highlight 'Profile' on the profile screen.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'See all' links, inactive nav labels, search placeholder) is light on a light background and has low contrast. The white delivery-time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also blend into the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio and add a subtle shadow or border to the pills over light images.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative translucent circles that clip awkwardly at the corner and bottom edge. The 'Order now' button also sits close to the code text.
issues.suggestion: Reposition or clip the decorative shapes cleanly within the banner and add more spacing around the CTA.

issues.description: The badges are inconsistent. The delivery-time pills sit inside the image at bottom-left, while the '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges sit at top-left. The €0 delivery info is also repeated in the text below the card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge placement and remove duplicated information.
